frames.title: Two rough nights. Gym planned for 7.
Run the check. Pick one of three.

slides.title: What to tell your trainer after a broken night
slides.body: Short scripts for the start of a session.

slides.title: Before the warm-up, not halfway in
slides.body: It's easier to adjust a plan than to stop one.

slides.title: "Rough night. Lighter today, please."
slides.body: A modified plan is still the plan.

slides.title: "I'll take the easier option on each move."
slides.body: Useful in a class you don't want to miss.

slides.title: "I'll stop at 30 minutes today."
slides.body: Say your stop cue out loud. It's easier to keep.
